header:
Chess Assist v28.5 - popup UI (original: extension/assets/upo.js, loaded by assets/edn.html)

Readable version generated by my deobfuscation pipeline (tools/). Reference only; not loaded.
The 1 MB original is mostly 68 base64 PNG images + 2 MP3 click sounds; they are replaced here by
"<<BLOB_n:type:size>>" placeholders (the originals are still in extension/assets/upo.js).

The popup builds its whole 276x276 px UI with document.createElement + inline styles and NEVER talks
to the content script directly. Every button writes a key into chrome.storage.local; the content script
(assets/tne.js) listens with chrome.storage.onChanged and writes results back (move, score, lines, ...)
which this popup renders from its own onChanged listener. See docs/06-popup-and-settings.md.

The same page is also injected into the chess site as a draggable <object> ("floating panel").

Only the most important identifiers were renamed; UI helper locals keep their obfuscated names.

comments.renderAdvancedPanel:
ADVANCED MODE panel: 5 sliders stored as `eyleb` = [depth 1-15, contempt -100..100 ("SCORN"),
skill 0-20, skill max error 0-5000 ("ERROR"), skill probability 1-1000 ("DEVIATE")].
IMPORT/EXPORT saves them as Config.chessassist = the array base64-encoded 12 times.
comments.usernameInput:
LOGIN / REGISTER form. On submit the popup writes chrome.storage.local.qowr = [token, [username,
password, confirm, "l"|"r"]] (plain text, never cleared); the content script forwards it to the
licence server with socket.emit("jscbsh", ...).
comments.layoutPopup: Absolute positioning of every element (the popup has no CSS layout).
comments.waitForContentScript:
Poll until the content script reports an active board (state_function == "YES"), then subscribe to
storage changes and mirror engine output (move, score, suggestion lines, eval breakdown) into the UI.
